subject: AcmeCloud — Procurement readiness & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud — Procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Alicia — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on the procurement path and timeline.

Recap (from discovery)
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Hosted API for initial pilot; potential Dedicated later if throughput requires.
- Primary procurement path: Finance prefers PO; procurement evaluating marketplace approach (AWS Marketplace) to simplify purchase.
- Security checklist: SOC 2 Type II report and pen-test summary required by security team.
- Legal items: standard MSA + Data Processing Addendum; some redlines expected around indemnity and data residency.

Suggested commercial options
1) PO via purchase order (standard 30/60 day net) — Redwood supports PO + invoice.
2) Credit card (faster for pilot, limited spend).
3) AWS Marketplace (OSS/marketplace contract) — we can enable marketplace invoicing but it adds vendor onboarding time on both sides.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
- Week 1 (this week): Share MPA draft and security artifacts — DONE (attached).
- Week 2: Legal review kickoff (Acme legal) — target complete by 2026-03-31.
- Week 3: Security review (SOC2 + pen test review, OKTA SSO config) — target complete by 2026-04-07.
- Week 4: Finance/Procurement issues PO or approve Marketplace purchase — target by 2026-04-14.

Attachments: AcmeCloud-MPA-draft.pdf (draft mutual action plan)

Ask from your side
- Can you confirm primary procurement contact and whether PO is required for the pilot?
- Is AcmeCloud planning to buy via AWS Marketplace for vendor simplification?
- Any hard dates from Legal or Security we should know about?

I can loop in our Contracts team and Solutions Engineering (Marcus) to answer any technical/security questions. Happy to jump on a quick 20m call if that helps accelerate sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Samuel Park <s.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud — Procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement: Our Finance team prefers a PO for anything > $10k; pilot likely to require a PO.
- Marketplace: We are strongly interested in buying through AWS Marketplace to centralize vendor management, but that requires vendor onboarding on our side and may add 1-2 weeks.
- Security: our security team requires SOC 2 Type II and a recent pen test summary; they usually complete vendor security reviews in ~1 week after receiving artifacts.
- Legal: our legal team typically takes ~2 weeks for an MSA review with standard redlines.

I've looped in Samuel (procurement) — he will be the PO owner. Samuel, can you confirm the procurement contact info and any required PO templates?

A couple of asks for Redwood:
1) Please share the SOC2 report and pen-test summary (or a pointer to where we can download them).
2) Can you send the MPA/SOW and indicate whether Redwood is set up for AWS Marketplace billing?

Appreciate it — happy to sync live if needed.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez | Head of Platform Integrations
AcmeCloud
agomez@acmecloud.com

Hi Alicia — thanks for the quick responses and for looping in Samuel. Copying Marcus to help with the security/technical artifacts and to confirm marketplace support.

Per your asks, attaching our security checklist and a more detailed MPA spreadsheet that maps owners and milestones. Below is a proposed milestone table we can commit to:

MPA (proposed milestones)
- 2026-03-24: Redwood to share SOC 2 and pen-test summary, and MPA v1 — ATTACHED.
- 2026-03-31: Legal review complete (Acme legal sign-off or consolidated redlines).
- 2026-04-07: Security review complete (SOC2 & pen test accepted, SSO config validated).
- 2026-04-14: Finance/Procurement issues PO or confirms AWS Marketplace purchase.

Notes/assumptions
- If Acme wants to buy through AWS Marketplace, vendor onboarding may shift Finance milestone +7-14 days.
- For pilot purchases under $25k, Finance can sometimes expedite and accept a card payment; if you want to go that route let us know.
- If Legal raises redlines, we suggest a 1-week turnaround on our side to review and return.

Attachments: MPA-v1.xlsx (MPA with owners & dates), Redwood-Security-Checklist.pdf

Next step: Samuel — can you confirm PO template and target PO date? If Marketplace is preferred, can you confirm vendor onboarding owner so we can coordinate?

Thanks,
Marissa
